craft_notes: Sthāyin: burning-verse (city = mind-city). Rows: row 2 (burnt→calm-shine). Close: may-be (opens what the ash makes). Rejected: 'antarāṭman' gloss for pura — killed: city kept (image intact); 'smolders' — killed: burnt (complete).

lines: By time-fire from time-place risen, own city burnt:
at end calm-shining — then it may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kālāgninā kālapadād utthitena svakam puram | pluṣṭam vicintayed ante śāntābhāsas tadā bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What burns? → Burning the city in time-fire ends in calm-shining.
c1_essence: Time-fire burns own city: calm-shining at the end.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
